text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky achieved numerous brilliant 
results in the Twinkle Series.

Having drawn attention even before her 
debut, she delivered a performance that 
far exceeded even those high expectations—

“And what she left behind was not just 
brilliant results.”
(VROOM VRRRROOOOOM!! Skrrrrt)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Trainer-kun! Sorry to keep you 
waiting!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Trainer-chan! Sorry to keep you 
waiting!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'll take you to a totally groovy 
spot that's super hip with the cool kids!
choice_data_list: Is this really a trendy spot?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on~ You doubt me? I've always got 
my eye on the latest trends, so I know 
what I'm talking about!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hop in, hop in! Let's enjoy the best hot 
holiday ever~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay, we've arrived~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My, you look surprised.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Coming here means you can always enjoy 
top-tier races, you know? Whether you're 
cheering or running!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Maruzensky!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It really is you! Um, I'm always cheering 
for you! Good luck in your next race!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, ufufu! Thank you~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, I get to meet famous Umamusume like 
this! Just kidding, tee-hee~♪"
choice_data_list: It really is a buzzing hotspot.
It really is a buzzing hotspot.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Right? Everyone around us looks like 
they're having so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, let's go watch the most 
exciting race!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
200 meters to go! Finding a gap on the 
inside, she bursts right through!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She broke clear, she broke clear! Living 
up to her status as the race favorite, she 
crosses the finish liiine in 1st place!!
(WAAAAAHHH~~~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Congrats on 1st place!!

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"We'll be rooting for you next time too! 
Show us your best race!"

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll do my best~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"That got me so fired up! 
Congratulations!"

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah!? Maruzensky-san!

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'll be able to run in the same race with 
Maruzensky-san soon, so please wait for 
me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm waiting! Let's have a fun race~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, racecourses really are packed full 
of "fun," aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
At first, I used to wonder about running 
just for the fun of it, you know~

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's why I was hesitant to make my 
debut, and even thought maybe it'd be 
better if I didn't run at all...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Still, right now, I'm truly glad I kept 
on running!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by adorable juniors and rivals 
alike, I just can't help having the time 
of my life!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This is all thanks to you supporting me, 
Trainer-kun!
choice_data_list: I just wanted to see you run.
I just wanted to see you run.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This is all thanks to you supporting me, 
Trainer-chan!
choice_data_list: I just wanted to see you run.
I just wanted to see you run.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, having my running praised makes me 
happier than anything...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, to live up to those 
expectations, I gotta keep running my 
absolute best from now on!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course you'll watch over me, right? 
From my passenger seat...!
choice_data_list: I'm counting on you from here on out, too.

I'm looking forward to working with you 
going forward, too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Let's keep running with the pedal to 
the metal!
